task: DATA is a list of students, each with name and 3 scores. Weights for the 3 scores are 0.2, 0.3, 0.5. Compute weighted averages rounded to 2 decimals. Passing means average >= 60. Output a single JSON object with averages (mapping names to average), class_average (2 decimals, computed from unrounded individual averages), passed (alphabetically sorted names), and highest (the name whose unrounded weighted average is greatest; choose the alphabetically first name only when the greatest scores tie). DATA is already defined; compute all outputs from it without redefining or copying the dataset into source.

rules.averages: Use weights 0.2, 0.3, 0.5 in score order, then round individual values to two decimals.
rules.class_average: Average the UNROUNDED weighted values, then round the class result to two decimals.
rules.passed: Include students with weighted score >= 60; sort names alphabetically.
rules.highest: Choose the name with the GREATEST unrounded weighted score. Alphabetical order breaks only a tie at the greatest score.
